## AeroDash v0.3.0-alpha - Fleet Management (Local Persistence)

This milestone moves AeroDash from a single hardcoded test aircraft to a user-managed fleet that persists in the browser, runs fully offline, and enforces the safety states required for real airframe operations.

### What's Included

- **Aircraft fleet CRUD with IndexedDB persistence:** create, read, update, delete and version-pin aircraft profiles locally; ICAO registration validation and duplicate detection (REQ-AC-001..004)
- **Draft / Verified profile status with immutable versioned snapshots:** Verified profiles cannot be mutated in place; editing a Verified profile creates a new Draft snapshot; selecting a Draft profile prepends `WARN-AC-002` to every Mass & Balance result (REQ-AC-005, H-011)
- **Passenger profiles with standard weights:** named pilot / passenger profiles with stored standard weights, surfaced in load inputs (REQ-AC-006, REQ-UI-006)
- **Aircraft profile import / export:** download any profile as `.aerodash.json` from the fleet list and re-import on another device; Zod-validated exchange-file format (REQ-AC-004)
- **Manufacturer / model / ICAO catalogue selector:** versioned `aircraft-model-catalogue.json` with manufacturer-filtered model dropdown, ICAO auto-fill on model selection, and reverse lookup from ICAO designator (REQ-UI-001..004)
- **Native battery-electric aircraft support:** new `powertrain` discriminator and `batteryPack` sub-entity (usable energy, reserve floor, optional voltage / chemistry); dedicated wizard step; "Energy & Endurance" labelling on electric airframes; Pipistrel Velis Electro shipped in the catalogue (REQ-AD-020/021, ADR-009)
- **5-step aircraft creation wizard:** Identity → Certification & Envelope → Weighing Reports → Load Stations → Review & Save, with forward-lock validation, dirty-route guard, and Draft save (REQ-AC-001, REQ-UQ-003)
- **Accordion-style profile editor:** Identity, Certification & Envelope, Weighing Reports, Battery Pack (electric), and Load Stations sections with sticky Save footer; per-station allowable-categories selector and burn-sequence editor on fuel tanks
- **PWA offline-first with Service Worker app-shell caching:** the app shell loads and Mass & Balance completes with no network connectivity (REQ-SYS-001/002)
- **Update lifecycle and minimum safe version enforcement:** in-session updates surface `INFO-SYS-001` and require pilot confirmation; cold-start updates apply silently; a build below `minSafeVersion` is blocked behind a full-screen gate (REQ-SYS-005/006, H-019, ADR-007, ADR-316)
- **Session auto-save / restore:** active Mass & Balance pilot inputs are debounced into `localStorage` and restored on page reload — no more lost preflight state (REQ-SYS-013)
- **Hot-swap active aircraft mid-session:** change the active airframe without a full page reload; Mass & Balance store fully detaches stale prior-aircraft data (REQ-AC-005)
- **`schemaVersion` field on `AircraftContext` and structured IndexedDB migrations** (REQ-SYS-002, ADR-008)
- **Canonical bilinear interpolation engine and 40 hand-verified test vectors in CI** for TOR / TOD / LR / LD — de-risk for the v0.4.0 performance distance calculations (REQ-AD-008/009)
- **Mobile / cockpit UX hardening:** 44×44 px (≥48 px on mobile) icon buttons meeting WCAG 2.2 AAA target size; reusable `DecimalInput` accepting `.` and `,` for European pilots; iOS Safari sticky / clipping / decimal fixes; SemVer + build date displayed in the About section (REQ-UI-013, REQ-UQ-003)
- **Documentation:** `ASSUMPTIONS.md` (device capabilities, user competence, catalogue scope); ADR-007 (aircraft data update pipeline); ADR-008 (IndexedDB migration strategy); ADR-009 (powertrain discriminator); ADR-010 (canonical status values); ADR-316 (PWA update lifecycle); aircraft exchange-file format specification
- **Engineering / traceability:** `trace/` YAML registries populated for AC / AD / SYS / UI modules (91 milestone REQ refs); CI Traceability Gate enforced; Vite 8 upgrade with pinned browser-baseline targets; transitive vulnerability patches via `pnpm.overrides` (`basic-ftp`, `ip-address`, `uuid`); developer tooling migrated from `.cursor/` to Claude Code primitives under `.claude/`

### What This Release Means

`v0.3.0-alpha` makes AeroDash usable on a real airframe owned by a real pilot, fully offline. Profiles persist across sessions and devices, the Verified safety state is enforced at the calculation entry point, the PWA installs and runs without connectivity, and the next-step performance work has a verified mathematical foundation. The product moves from a walking skeleton into an operational preflight tool — still alpha, still not certified, but functionally complete for offline Mass & Balance on a personally-managed fleet.

### Known Scope Limits

- Performance distance calculations (takeoff / landing roll, climb / descent profile) are deferred to `v0.4.0`; the bilinear interpolation engine is shipped and validated but not yet wired into a user-facing performance module
- Fuel endurance and obstacle planning are deferred to `v0.5.0`
- Online weather and airport data integration are deferred to `v0.6.0`
- PDF / print export is deferred to `v0.7.0`
- Authentication and cloud synchronization are deferred to `v0.8.0`
- `minSafeVersion` is currently a build-time constant; the planned remote-fetch upgrade lands before `v1.0.0` GA

### What's Next

`v0.4.0-alpha` will deliver the Performance module: takeoff and landing distance calculations driven by per-aircraft POH performance tables, using the bilinear interpolation engine and canonical test vectors validated in this release. Pilots will get runway-vs-aircraft Go / No-Go advisories tied to live pressure altitude and mass inputs.
